messages:
Anya: Quick heads-up — seeing weird spectral head-shifts after int4 conversion when loading Gemma->Mistral variant. logits for first 16 tokens jump in 2 heads.
Sam: Oh interesting. got an example diff? :eyes:
Anya: Pasted a tiny diff from eval:
```
seed prompt: "The quick brown fox..."
head 3 pre-quant mean logits: [-0.12, 0.05, -0.03, 0.01, ...]
head 3 post-quant mean logits: [1.9, -0.3, 2.1, -0.8, ...]
```
Liam: that's huge. did you check kv cache layout/padding? sounds like head-dim misalign
Daria: Could be headstride mismatch — Gemma export had head_dim=64 vs Mistral expect 128? but that would be obvious earlier.
Anya: We ruled out shape mismatch — shapes match. suspect layout permutation or byte-order in per-head q/k weights. reproducible on CPU and CUDA.
Sam: Try swapping per-head endian or doing a headwise sum check. Also run on int8 to see if quantization sharpening is the culprit.
Anya: Ran int8 — smaller but still present. int4 amplifies.
triage-bot: linked run: https://ci.internal/runs/3795123456 :heavy_check_mark:
Liam: Can you dump first-layer q,k weight hex of head 3 from both binaries? I'll diff for permutation.
Anya: uploading snippets to /tmp/gemma_mistral_head3.hex (shared)
Daria: If it's per-head packing maybe packing stride differs (row-major vs packed). I can try a converter that reorders by head index.
Sam: FYI, I saw a similar pattern with spectral-embedding mismatch on Nova earlier — turned out to be rotary scale applied twice on export.
Anya: Good call — I checked rotary flags, Mistral exporter set rotary_scale=1.0 but Gemma had learned scale param=1.2. maybe exporter normalized incorrectly.
Sam: Can you run small-generation regression (safety prompts) and check top-1 token diffs before/after converter?
Anya: Doing that now. Will post results in 10m. :hourglass:
ci-bot: build 3795123460 finished — tests green
Sam: Thanks — if it's rotary-scale bug we should add a quick smoke to conversion tests to catch the headwise magnitude shift.
Anya: Agreed — putting a short PR to add stat-checks on q/k per-head mean/std after conversion.
Daria: Ping me on the PR, I'll review and try the reordering patch.
Sam: Nice work. keep updates here.
